The final gate and review are emitted as owner-controlled sidecars after the last product commit, so neither artifact advances the reviewed product HEAD.

The durable coordinator amendment preserves the consumed attempts and authorizes exactly one final closure candidate/review for these four findings.

The normalized child request base SHA must equal the sealed manifest parent SHA before pipeline compilation or any child worktree/provider effect; unit and moved-branch public-facade regressions prove fail-closed behavior.

An already accepted child reconstructs its sealed base from the immutable launch receipt, while new launches still require the normalized request base and any receipt/manifest base drift fails closed; public replay tests prove zero duplicate launch effects when raw base_sha was omitted.
